1. == - check the left and right values
2. === - check the left and right values along with their data types
3. > - check if the left expression is greater than the right expression
4. < check if the left expression is smaller than the right expression
5. >= - whether the left expression is greater than or equal to the right expression
6. =< - whether the left expression is less than or equal to the right expression
7. != - left expression is not equal to right expression

defer -> It will wait till the end of HTML rendering, then it will process the script.
async -> it will delegate the execution not necessarily till the end of HTML rendering
integrity -> it check for the hash key within the script tag and the file / response received
from the server. if it is not the same the browser will refuse to process the script
cross-origin -> it checks if we can access the server either anonymously or by adding
some credentials in the form of cookies
